description: Defines inline functions for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) feature support checks based on connection features and compile-time configuration flags.

methods.name: feature_unmask_features
methods.description: Unmasks specific features in the connection by clearing bits in features_used.

methods.name: feature_unmask_peer_features
methods.description: Unmasks peer features in the connection.

methods.name: feature_le_encryption
methods.description: Checks if LE encryption feature is supported based on compile-time config.

methods.name: feature_conn_param_req
methods.description: Checks if connection parameter request feature is supported.

methods.name: feature_ext_rej_ind
methods.description: Checks if extended reject indication feature is supported.

methods.name: feature_periph_feat_req
methods.description: Checks if peripheral feature request is supported.

methods.name: feature_le_ping
methods.description: Checks if LE ping feature is supported.

methods.name: feature_dle
methods.description: Checks if Data Length Extension is supported.

methods.name: feature_privacy
methods.description: Checks if privacy feature is supported.

methods.name: feature_ext_scan
methods.description: Checks if extended scan feature is supported.

methods.name: feature_chan_sel_2
methods.description: Checks if channel selection algorithm 2 is supported.

methods.name: feature_min_used_chan
methods.description: Checks if minimum used channels feature is supported.

methods.name: feature_phy_2m
methods.description: Checks if 2M PHY is supported.

methods.name: feature_phy_coded
methods.description: Checks if coded PHY is supported.

methods.name: feature_cte_req
methods.description: Checks if CTE request feature is supported.

methods.name: feature_sca
methods.description: Checks if SCA update feature is supported.

methods.name: feature_smi_rx
methods.description: Checks if SMI RX feature is supported.

methods.name: feature_peer_smi_rx
methods.description: Checks if peer supports SMI RX.

methods.name: feature_smi_tx
methods.description: Checks if SMI TX feature is supported.

methods.name: feature_peer_smi_tx
methods.description: Checks if peer supports SMI TX.

methods.name: feature_peer_iso_central
methods.description: Checks if peer supports ISO central.

methods.name: feature_iso_central
methods.description: Checks if ISO central feature is supported.

methods.name: feature_peer_iso_peripheral
methods.description: Checks if peer supports ISO peripheral.

methods.name: feature_iso_peripheral
methods.description: Checks if ISO peripheral feature is supported.
